Hi Matt — thanks for the clear ask and the spreadsheet. Short answers up front:

- Yes: console admin actions (role changes, invite/disable, policy edits), API key lifecycle (create/revoke/rotate), and system-level service actions are logged with actor, timestamp, IP, and request id.
- We support exportable bundles (JSONL or compressed Parquet), and we can produce a signed manifest (SHA256) and a timestamped delivery record for chain-of-custody.
- Default retention in Hosted is 12 months; Dedicated customers can configure longer windows up to 7 years depending on the reserved capacity plan. We also offer short-term retention tiers (30/90/180 days) for cost-sensitive workloads.

I’m looping in Laura for the export manifest template and Karthik for snapshot/playbook steps. I’ll also attach a prototype manifest and a short S3 presign playbook.

Next step: can you confirm whether Clearpath wants an on-demand export or a regularly scheduled monthly snapshot? That affects the packaging and transfer method.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher

Fyi — draft manifest and field mapping below (sending to attach to the Clearpath bundle).

Manifest (high level):
- bundle_id: GUID
- created_at: ISO8601
- producer: redwood-inference
- manifest_hash: SHA256(manifest.json)
- files: [ { filename, size_bytes, sha256, record_count, record_schema_version } ]
- delivery: { method: s3_presigned | sftp | gs://, delivered_by, delivered_at }

Field mapping highlights (to include in README for auditors):
- actor_id: internal user id (mapped to email)
- action_type: grant_role | revoke_role | api_key_create | api_key_revoke | settings_update
- resource: resource path (project/model/route)
- request_id: opaque request identifier to cross-link telemetry
- ip_address: source IP (redacted on request with justification)

Packaging recommendations:
- Provide both a JSONL export and a compressed Parquet for high-volume customers.
- Include a README.md with field definitions and sample jq commands to verify hashes.
- For chain-of-custody, provide the manifest plus a signed delivery receipt (we can sign with our key).

I attached the template and a short playbook for generating presigned S3 bundles. Karthik — any operational caveats for Dedicated?

—Laura
Laura Bennett

Hi Matt — operational notes from Dedicated/ops side:

- Snapshot windowing: we can produce point-in-time snapshots using our export agent. For Dedicated we run the agent inside the customer subnet and stream to the customer S3. For Hosted we ship bundle to a customer-controlled S3 presign or to their Splunk/Datadog ingest endpoint.
- Performance: for very large accounts (>>100M events/month) we recommend nightly Parquet snapshots plus incremental JSONL deltas.
- Redaction/sampling: we can redact PII fields at export time if you provide a justification and an audit policy. Redaction is logged and included in the manifest.
- Signed manifests: we use SHA256 and provide a signed delivery receipt (PKCS#7) on request. We can also include a timestamped KMS envelope for long-term verifiability.

If Clearpath wants an automated monthly deliverable, we can onboard a retention configuration and provide a kickoff checklist for S3 permissions and a test export.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Operations — Redwood Inference
